description: Read up to five recorded repository events, newest first. The listing page carries the same available events as `history`; updates may be cached for up to 15 minutes. An empty list means no events are available, not proof that nothing changed or that collection covered the requested period. `generated_at` is the slice generation date, not a per-repository check date; it is empty when no slice was read. Stale means no push for 12 months. Reading does not refresh the source.

api_pass.description: MAT-only private pass: mat_<32 random hex>_<64 random hex>. Generate and save before buying.

retry_key.description: Optional retry key, up to 80 ASCII characters; same read for five minutes.
